title: Frame and validate reviewed stand-in instructions
summary: The Runtime prepends its fixed English frame, limits instruction bytes, checks the loaded text hash and keeps the stand-in within its reviewed authority. This is the host frame, not editable instruction data.

replaceability.why: The non-removable frame and the authority checks protect agent.replace; reviewed layers replace instruction text only.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, 2026-10-24; self-Luc spec v0.3 (2026-10-18); today's code: lumeri_runtime/luc_agent.py:50-73

operations.name: host_frame
operations.notes: No deadline is enforced; this is a synchronous in-process call.

operations.name: compile_package

capability.description: Agent capability declaration compiled by the Host. See iface:luc.host/v1.

files.description: Python mapping of package paths to bytes; instructions names a .md file. No file contents are copied into this contract.

output.description: Compiled capability with instructions_sha256 and host-owned empty-input/any-output schemas. See iface:luc.host/v1.

operations.notes: No deadline is enforced. ValueError also rejects invalid surface/name/title/path, empty or overlong instructions and excessive authority; Host translates validation exceptions into its own load refusals. This contract does not invent codes for those exceptions.

operations.name: instructions
operations.notes: No deadline is enforced; this is a synchronous in-process call.

invariants.text: The complete stand-in prompt is the Runtime frame followed by reviewed text, with the original product, max_tokens and max_cost_micros.

break: the operation raises unexpectedly or returns an answer outside its declared schema
failure.notes: Compile failures are handled by the Host load gate; runtime text changes become E_LUC_AGENT_CHANGED, then Worker fallback. The frame itself has no replacement seam.

conformance.notes: Existing tests are evidence for the named invariants, not a replacement conformance runner. Only the area contract checker is run in this task.
